known_deltas: Threshold audit: v3.0 literals in config.legacy_verification with IDENTICAL defaults.
Wikidata quirks (live-verified): API errors = HTTP 200 + {"error":{...}}; redirects parser supports list and dict forms.
Pleiades: unreachable from dev network; defensive parser + network-marker live test; hostname-only.
Trismegistos: no public API (SSL chain + 403) -> stub adapter; datasets deferred.
Fragment orthogonality (a086a4b): is_fragment=source lacuna; completeness_score=extraction quality; needs_attention aggregate.
Verification 2.0 (c201bb4) + logician fix (3daaf97): package aeon/verification/; <2 claims -> abstained.
1.4 (e5619be): verify_mode off/basic/full; demo CLI; MockLLM->aeon/testing.py (latency_ms); coverage runner 92%.

CVI formula documented: negatives dominate; no positives -> abstained; CVI = mean confidence of POSITIVE verdicts (round 4); <0.50 abstained; needs_review <0.85. Demo mean(0.91,0.90)=0.905 -> '0.91' (.2f).
Real-API gap: mock extrapolation (200ms/call); real DeepSeek ~1.5-4s/call -> 4 calls ~6-16s; multi-focus up to 12 calls -> backlog 2.7 parallelization.
Coverage: TOTAL 92%, all new modules >=73%; runner tools/run_coverage.py cross-platform; coverage pinned >=7.4,<8.0.
